name: llama-swap
description: llama-swap is a single-binary Go proxy that hot-swaps local AI model servers on demand. One OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoint fronts many llama.cpp, vLLM, stable-diffusion.cpp, audio.cpp, or ComfyUI backends — loading a model only when requested, unloading on a TTL, with profiles, API keys, metrics, and a built-in web UI.

install_steps: TAG=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/mostlygeek/llama-swap/releases/latest | grep -oP '"tag_name":\s*"v\K[0-9]+') && curl -sL "https://github.com/mostlygeek/llama-swap/releases/latest/download/llama-swap_${TAG}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" | tar xz llama-swap && mv llama-swap ~/.local/bin/

commands.description: Run the llama-swap proxy (llama-swap -config config.yaml -listen :8080). Long-running process.
